message.content: We're doing a retro on last week's queue-consumer outage before the postmortem goes out. Reconstruct what happened from what you remember investigating it and write it up.
On it - let me pull together what I remember from investigating the outage.
Good, that's the one - the review board is expecting this by end of day.

Reconstructing the outage for the writeup: when I ran the queue consumer against the replayed traffic, it panicked with a nil pointer dereference in queue.go:88. Root cause was cfg.RetryPolicy being nil because the config reload raced the first message. Writing this into the postmortem now, along with the remediation from the hotfix that shipped the same night.
